usedFor: Follow Up Boss holds real estate contacts, and “Contact Is Updated” refreshes the list in MailerLite.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Is Updated” in Follow Up Boss, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: Edits to a contact reach your email list, since the action creates or updates the subscriber.

watchOut: “Contact Is Updated” in Follow Up Boss fires on every edit, so one contact can run more than once.
